features.name: Sign-in, logout and student account access
features.currentEvidence: Shell and fixed mock student session exist; logout is a no-op. Login, password recovery and real sessions are absent.
features.nextStep: Confirm legacy login or SSO and account provisioning.

features.name: Online application form for new applicants
features.currentEvidence: No applicant signup, application, intake-choice or application-status route exists.
features.nextStep: Confirm the minimum applicant journey and required fields.

features.name: Admissions document submission and English entry checks
features.currentEvidence: No applicant upload or English-entry checking flow. Enrolled-student qualification records are displayed in Profile only.
features.nextStep: Define evidence requirements and programme/country entry rules.

features.name: Institution, programme and delivery-site approval checks
features.currentEvidence: No accreditation register or campus/programme/delivery-mode approval workflow.
features.nextStep: Collect current approval evidence for each intended campus and programme.

features.name: Qualification level, credits and duration verification
features.currentEvidence: Study plan and prior qualifications show sample values; no national-framework mapping or admissions decision tool.
features.nextStep: Approve country-specific qualification and credit comparisons without automatic equivalence.

features.name: Foreign equivalency and professional recognition
features.currentEvidence: No authority evaluation, home-country recognition, professional approval or appeal workflow.
features.nextStep: Document who verifies foreign awards and records the authority decision.

features.name: Application review, offers and first university enrolment
features.currentEvidence: Students already exist in mock scenarios; admissions decisions and offer acceptance are absent.
features.nextStep: Map the application-to-student process in the old CMS.

features.name: Personal details and emergency contacts
features.currentEvidence: Contact, address and emergency-contact edits work only within one mock session.
features.nextStep: Agree which updates save directly and which need staff approval.

features.name: Student documents library
features.currentEvidence: Student/university file lists are built; all View and Download actions are no-op placeholders.
features.nextStep: Agree document permissions and authorised file delivery.

features.name: Semester subject and class registration
features.currentEvidence: Module selection, prerequisite/clash/credit checks and first-confirmation mock invoices work; this is not admissions registration.
features.nextStep: Validate legacy registration rules and atomic save requirements.

features.name: Class timetable
features.currentEvidence: Student semester and module schedules are implemented, read-only.
features.nextStep: Map current timetable records and update rules from the old CMS.

features.name: Attendance records
features.currentEvidence: Student present/absent views and calendars exist; recording/correcting attendance is not a student workflow.
features.nextStep: Identify the authoritative attendance source and staff correction workflow.

features.name: Grades, results and student progress
features.currentEvidence: Published grade/GPA/CGPA and assessment-breakdown views exist; no staff marking or publication workflow.
features.nextStep: Confirm result approval/publication rules and legacy data fields.

features.name: Study plan and prerequisites
features.currentEvidence: Curriculum journey, completed credits and prototype graduation checks exist; they are not campus compliance approval.
features.nextStep: Validate programme versions, prerequisites and credit-transfer rules.

features.name: Graduation clearance and transcripts
features.currentEvidence: Graduation is a blank tab and Download Transcript does nothing.
features.nextStep: Define clearance steps and authorised transcript/certificate delivery.

features.name: Important announcements
features.currentEvidence: Dashboard announcement preview cards exist; cards have no open/detail action, and there is no staff publishing or acknowledgement workflow.
features.nextStep: Confirm audiences, publishing ownership, full announcement viewing and the real feed.

features.name: Study guides
features.currentEvidence: Generic Materials can list resources, but no explicit study-guide workflow or functional guide access is implemented.
features.nextStep: Identify required guides and arrange lecturer publishing and student access.

features.name: Lecture notes and learning-media access
features.currentEvidence: Released resources, including notes/videos/links, display in Materials but their actions are no-ops.
features.nextStep: Enable authorised resource viewing/download and supported media delivery.

features.name: Assignment briefs
features.currentEvidence: Assignment details and brief metadata exist; the brief filename/download action is a placeholder.
features.nextStep: Provide real brief files and release/access rules.

features.name: Submit, replace and withdraw assignments
features.currentEvidence: One-file PDF/ZIP submit/replace/delete demonstration stores metadata only; file bytes are never uploaded.
features.nextStep: Agree durable secure submission storage and staff receipt/marking handoff.

features.name: Revision work and practice activities
features.currentEvidence: No explicit revision-work workflow, formative activity engine or progress tracking.
features.nextStep: Define revision materials and any required practice/feedback activities.

features.name: Past examination papers
features.currentEvidence: No explicit past-paper library or publication/access policy; generic resource placeholders do not count as delivery.
features.nextStep: Identify approved papers and access/release restrictions.

features.name: Course information and learning outcomes
features.currentEvidence: Module summary, lecturers, timetable and assessment outline exist; structured learning outcomes are not represented.
features.nextStep: Add approved outcomes and complete course information to the contract.

features.name: Online quizzes and examinations
features.currentEvidence: Assessment information can be listed; taking quizzes/exams, attempts and results processing are absent.
features.nextStep: Define assessment modes, allowed attempts and approval/integrity requirements.

features.name: Student–lecturer and student–student communication
features.currentEvidence: Programme/module/personal/service chat works in one mock session; messages are not actually delivered to other users.
features.nextStep: Agree persistent communication, moderation and response responsibilities.

features.name: Live online classes
features.currentEvidence: Online delivery labels or timetable locations do not launch or provide a live-teaching service.
features.nextStep: Confirm whether and how an approved meeting tool will be integrated.

features.name: Self-paced learning and release schedules
features.currentEvidence: Dated learning weeks and release-aware lists exist; resource access and completion tracking are incomplete.
features.nextStep: Define the self-paced learning journey and release/completion rules.

features.name: Marking and lecturer feedback
features.currentEvidence: No marking workspace, rubric, feedback return or moderation workflow; displayed historic grades are sample records.
features.nextStep: Confirm staff marking, feedback and publication workflows in the old CMS.

features.name: Assessment identity and academic integrity
features.currentEvidence: No exam identity checks, anti-impersonation or plagiarism integration; client-side file validation does not supply these.
features.nextStep: Confirm required identity and integrity controls for each delivery mode.

features.name: Student feedback and course evaluation
features.currentEvidence: Lecturer Review is a visible no-op button; no survey or feedback reporting workflow.
features.nextStep: Approve survey scope, confidentiality and reporting ownership.

features.name: Digital library and e-resources
features.currentEvidence: Services describes physical libraries; it is not a searchable digital library or authorized e-resource connection.
features.nextStep: Identify licensed resources and library access integration.

features.name: Student orientation and digital-learning skills
features.currentEvidence: No student induction, help course or ICT competency workflow.
features.nextStep: Prepare induction content and required completion evidence.

features.name: Learner support and IT helpdesk
features.currentEvidence: Service chat is a mock demonstration and Requests is a blank page; no real ticketing, SLA or staffed helpdesk evidence.
features.nextStep: Confirm support channels, owners, operating hours and escalation process.

features.name: Study-centre and regional support
features.currentEvidence: No study-centre directory, allocation or remote learner support workflow; old-campus arrangements are unverified.
features.nextStep: Confirm centres, local support arrangements and evidence required.

features.name: Accessibility and special-needs support
features.currentEvidence: Many controls have keyboard/accessibility coverage, but no full accessibility conformance audit or accommodation workflow.
features.nextStep: Audit journeys with assistive technology and confirm student support adjustments.

features.name: Mobile portal shell and device access
features.currentEvidence: Whole-portal mobile is not implemented or accepted. Only isolated Services body content has responsive test coverage.
features.nextStep: Design and verify the portal shell/navigation on agreed phone/tablet widths.

features.name: Connectivity, capacity and service monitoring
features.currentEvidence: No frontend evidence can establish campus internet adequacy or production platform capacity/reliability.
features.nextStep: Assess real connectivity, expected users, uptime targets and monitoring.

features.name: Backups and continuity
features.currentEvidence: No production data service is implemented here; old CMS backup/recovery capability has not been assessed.
features.nextStep: Verify backup ownership, restore tests and continuity arrangements.

features.name: Privacy, permissions and cybersecurity
features.currentEvidence: Student-scoped mock projections and safe file checks exist; real authorization, security operations and privacy controls are absent here.
features.nextStep: Confirm applicable policies and implement server-enforced access and security controls.

features.name: Learning analytics and quality monitoring
features.currentEvidence: GPA/attendance student displays exist, but staff engagement analytics, risk alerts and QA reporting are absent.
features.nextStep: Define useful learning/engagement measures and evidence reports.

features.name: Staff training and competence
features.currentEvidence: Institutional training cannot be inferred from this student frontend repository.
features.nextStep: Verify current training records and plan role-based LMS training.

features.name: Copyright and external provider controls
features.currentEvidence: Imported-asset provenance exists for Services; this does not establish learning-resource rights or third-party/cross-border approval.
features.nextStep: Confirm content permissions and provider/cross-border agreements.

features.name: Course-material review and LMS readiness evidence
features.currentEvidence: No staff material approval, pre-testing/pilot or regulator-readiness evidence workflow.
features.nextStep: Define material approval and retain pilot/readiness evidence.

features.name: Staff, lecturer and administrator workspaces
features.currentEvidence: No staff or lecturer application routes; a student-facing Materials area alone is not a complete LMS.
features.nextStep: Identify required staff actions and which remain in the old CMS for launch.

features.name: Finance balances, invoices and payment history
features.currentEvidence: Account/invoice/payment/adjustment views use a mock ledger; instructions include fictional banking information.
features.nextStep: Map real ledger data and confirm approved campus payment instructions.

features.name: Bank-transfer proof submission
features.currentEvidence: Students can submit/change/withdraw proof metadata; no actual upload or staff verification occurs.
features.nextStep: Connect secure proof storage and staff verification without treating proof as payment.

features.name: Online payment and financial documents
features.currentEvidence: No online payment flow; invoice download is a disabled placeholder, with no receipt delivery.
features.nextStep: Confirm gateway or legacy payment route and receipt/invoice generation.

features.name: Scholarships and incentives
features.currentEvidence: Read-only award/renewal/credit displays exist; applications and staff award assignment are absent.
features.nextStep: Confirm award ownership, terms and approval processes.

features.name: Resume and portfolio builders
features.currentEvidence: Both edit flows work with temporary local data; no durable storage, resume export or public portfolio sharing.
features.nextStep: Confirm launch priority and permanent save/export requirements.

features.name: Immigration and visa processing
features.currentEvidence: International students see a blank Immigration page; personal visa information and mock eligibility checks are not visa case management.
features.nextStep: Define campus/country visa stages, evidence and staff actions.

features.name: Student requests, complaints and academic appeals
features.currentEvidence: Requests is a blank page; no online forms, routing or approval tracking.
features.nextStep: Confirm request and appeal types, staff decisions and published response times.

features.name: Accommodation management
features.currentEvidence: Standalone Accommodation is blank; Services Accommodation supplies read-only information only.
features.nextStep: Confirm housing request/allocation workflow and legacy records.

features.name: Existing CMS integration and campus configuration
features.currentEvidence: Replaceable API contracts, mock campus ownership and student scopes exist; no authenticated HTTP adapter or live CMS connection.
features.nextStep: Inventory existing endpoints/data ownership and agree the launch integration contract.

features.name: Campus services information
features.currentEvidence: Seven read-only Cyberjaya categories have content; other campuses need approved content. No booking/payment workflow.
features.nextStep: Supply and approve campus-specific content and publishing ownership.

features.name: University policies for students
features.currentEvidence: Documents includes handbook metadata; no confirmed policy collection, actual file delivery, version/acknowledgement workflow.
features.nextStep: Identify approved student policies and decide publication/acknowledgement needs.
